local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local SilentAim = {
    Enabled = true,
    TeamCheck = true,
    WallCheck = true,
    FOV = 35,
    AimPart = "Head"
}

local function getCharacter(player)
    return player and player.Character
end

local function isAlive(character)
    if not character then
        return false
    end

    if character:GetAttribute("Dead") then
        return false
    end

    local health = character:GetAttribute("Health")

    return health == nil or health > 0
end

local function isObstructed(origin, target, character)
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, LocalPlayer.Character }

    local ray = workspace:Raycast(origin, target - origin, params)

    return ray ~= nil
        and ray.Instance ~= nil
        and not ray.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character)
end

local function getTarget(origin)
    local localTeam = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team")
    local look = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
    local best, bestAngle = nil, math.rad(SilentAim.FOV)

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player == LocalPlayer then
            continue
        end

        local character = getCharacter(player)

        if not isAlive(character) then
            continue
        end

        if SilentAim.TeamCheck and player:GetAttribute("Team") == localTeam then
            continue
        end

        local part = character:FindFirstChild(SilentAim.AimPart)
            or character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if not part then
            continue
        end

        local targetPos = part.Position
        local direction = (targetPos - origin).Unit
        local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(look:Dot(direction), -1, 1))

        if angle < bestAngle then
            if SilentAim.WallCheck and isObstructed(origin, targetPos, character) then
                continue
            end

            best, bestAngle = part, angle
        end
    end

    return best
end

local function buildHit(origin, part)
    local targetPos = part.Position
    local direction = (targetPos - origin).Unit

    return {
        Distance = (targetPos - origin).Magnitude,
        Instance = part,
        Position = targetPos,
        Normal = -direction,
        Material = part.Material.Name,
        Exit = false
    }
end

local ok, Remotes = pcall(require, game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Database.Security.Remotes)
local shootRemote = ok and Remotes and Remotes.Inventory and Remotes.Inventory.ShootWeapon

if not shootRemote or not shootRemote.Send then
    warn("BloxStrike silent aim: Remotes.Inventory.ShootWeapon.Send not found, hook skipped")
    return
end

local oldSend

local function hookedSend(packet, ...)
    if SilentAim.Enabled and packet and packet.Bullets then
        for _, bullet in ipairs(packet.Bullets) do
            local origin = bullet.Origin

            if origin then
                local part = getTarget(origin)

                if part then
                    bullet.Direction = (part.Position - origin).Unit
                    bullet.Hits = { buildHit(origin, part) }
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return oldSend(packet, ...)
end

if typeof(hookfunction) == "function" then
    oldSend = hookfunction(shootRemote.Send, hookedSend)
else
    oldSend = shootRemote.Send
    shootRemote.Send = hookedSend
end

        elseif mode == "Jitter" then
            local j = math.rad(math.random(-Settings.Aimbot.ResolverJitterRange, Settings.Aimbot.ResolverJitterRange)/10)
            return pos + Vector3.new(math.sin(j)*2, 0, math.cos(j)*2)
        elseif mode == "Spin" then
            local a = tick() * Settings.Aimbot.ResolverSpinSpeed
            return pos + Vector3.new(math.sin(math.rad(a % 360))*3, 0, math.cos(math.rad(a % 360))*3)
        end
        return pos

    local function GetTarget()
        local ef = GetEnemyFolder()
        if not ef then return nil end
        local best, bestDist = nil, Settings.Aimbot.FOV
        local center = Camera.ViewportSize/2
        for _, e in ipairs(ef:GetChildren()) do
            if IsAlive(e) then
                local p = e:FindFirstChild(Settings.Aimbot.AimPart) or e:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if p then
                    local sp, onScr = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(ApplyResolver(p.Position))
                    if onScr and sp.Z > 0 then
                        local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
                        if d < bestDist then bestDist = d; best = p end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best
    end

    local function ShootThroughWalls()
        if not Settings.Wallbang.Enabled then return end
        if not IsAlive(LocalPlayer.Character) then return end
        local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
        local ef = GetEnemyFolder()
        if not ef then return end
        for _, enemy in ipairs(ef:GetChildren()) do
            if IsAlive(enemy) then
                local head = enemy:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if head then
                    local dist = (head.Position - origin).Magnitude
                    if dist < Settings.Wallbang.MaxDistance then
                        local dir = (head.Position - origin).Unit
                        local params = RaycastParams.new()
                        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character, Camera}
                        local hit = Workspace:Raycast(origin, dir * dist, params)
                        if hit and hit.Instance then
                            local model = hit.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                            if model == enemy then
                                local screenPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
                                pcall(function()
                                    local vim = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
                                    vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y, 0, true, game, 1)
                                    task.wait(0.03)
                                    vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y, 0, false, game, 1)
                                end)
                                return
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
